observations: body: the figure stands at the left of lines 1 to 16, which are set beside it in a narrow measure; the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the right margin and the locators «p. 136.» (L11, left of the figure) and «p. 137.» (L33) in the left margin. The 3 of the line number 35 is printed broken.

body: the figure is redrawn from measurements of the print: its two circles (equal, as the text requires, of radius 77.05 and 77.06 pt) and its six straight lines are least-squares fits to the printed ink, and its fifteen letters (bold italic capitals) and the four words MERIDIES, ORIENS, OCCIDENS and SEPTENTRIONES (bold sans-serif capitals) stand where they are printed. The circle of the Moon runs through the word ORIENS, as in the print. In SEPTENTRIONES the first N is printed reversed; the redrawing keeps it.
body L11: in the locator «p. 136.» the last two figures are printed blotted; read as 136 between «p. 135.» (p. 89) and «p. 137.» (L33).
body L19: the t of «Puncta» is printed broken, like an l.
body L23, L24, L34, L37, L38: the o is printed thin, its two sides as broken strokes, in «cognosces», «Sole», «cognosce», «observator» (both) and «perpendiculo».
body L27: a speck stands low before «occi-»; it is not a sign.
body L36: the m of «simile» is printed broken.
notes_left L1: د is the Arabic letter dāl, which stands for D.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
